lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/ي/ت b–y–t tent, dwelling, abode, quarters
; family; to spend the night, to do something at night; to raid by night, (of food) to become stale.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 73 times in the Qur’an:
يَبِيتُون yabıtūn 1 time; بَيَّتَ bayyata 4 times; بَيْتٌ bayt 28 times; بُيُوتٌ buyūt 37 times and بَيَاتٌ bayāt 3 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
بَيْت bayt [n., pl. بُيُوتٌ buyūt]

1 tent

(16:80) وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ جُلُودِ الأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ and He has provided for you, from the hide of cattle, tents [lit. houses] that you find light on the day you travel and on the day you settle down

2 dwellings, rooms, houses

(7:74) وَتَنْحِتُونَ الْجِبَالَ بُيُوتًا and hewing the mountains into houses

3 mosques, places of worship

(24:36) فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ in houses of worship, God has ordained that they be raised high and His name be remembered in them; *

(2:125) الْبَيْتَ the House [at Mecca]; *

(5:2) الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ the Sacred House [in Mecca]; *

(33:33) أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ members of the Prophet’s household [lit. people of the House]

4 building

(24:29) لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَاعٌ لَكُمْ you will not be blamed for entering vacant/public buildings [lit. uninhabited houses] in which there is some errand/business for you..

entries.label: بَيَاتٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
بَيَاتٌ bayāt [v. n. used adverbially] at night, during the night; as a night raid

(7:97) أَفَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرَى أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ do the people of these towns feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them by night, while they are asleep?

entries.label: بَيَّتَ
entries.definitionHtml:
بَيَّتَ bayyata [v. II, trans.]

1 to do/decide something at night

(4:108) يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَلاَ يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ مَعَهُمْ إِذْ يُبَيِّتُونَ مَا لاَ يَرْضَى مِنَ الْقَوْلِ they hide from people, but they cannot hide from God, for He is with them while they plot at night discourse that He does not like

2 to raid someone at night; to kill someone at night

(27:49) قَالُوا تَقَاسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ they said, ‘Swear to one another [that] by God we shall attack him and his household in the night.’

entries.label: يِبِيتُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يِبِيتُ yabıt [imperf. of v. بَاتَ bāta, intrans.] to pass the night, to spend the night
